placeholder: Describe the decision problem, evidence gap, model change, or result you want to investigate…

starter.title: Start with the research question
starter.body: The agent structures the analysis, researches evidence, and maintains auditable files. You review assumptions and approve gates; forms stay secondary.

scope.title: Frame a cost-effectiveness study
scope.body: Define population, intervention, comparator, perspective, horizon, and outcome.
scope.prompt: Help me frame a cost-effectiveness study. Start by identifying the decision problem and only ask questions that would materially change the analysis.

search.title: Draft an evidence search
search.body: Prepare an exact public-source query for human-authorized retrieval.
search.prompt: Use $heor-evidence-search to draft heor/evidence-search-request.json for the current evidence gap. Do not make a network call. Use only PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, disclose the exact egress fields, validate the request, and leave execution for my explicit review in the AI4HEOR pane.

inputs.title: Research model inputs
inputs.body: Find current evidence, extract values, and keep sources separate from assumptions.
inputs.prompt: Help me research inputs for a pharmacoeconomic model. First identify the decision question and evidence gaps; keep sourced values separate from assumptions.

audit.title: Audit an existing plan
audit.body: Check structure, evidence traceability, unsupported inputs, and reference-case gaps.
audit.prompt: Audit the current HEOR analysis plan for structure, traceability, unsupported inputs, and reference-case gaps. Do not create approvals.

panel.title: Analysis review
panel.subtitle: Human-governed deterministic workflow
panel.noProjectBody: AI4HEOR artifacts and approvals are bound to the active project.
panel.emptyBody: Ask the agent to frame the decision problem. It will create heor/analysis-plan.json when the inputs are ready.
panel.revisionPrompt: Please revise heor/analysis-plan.json based on this request. Preserve valid existing evidence and make no human approval claims:

status.stale: Prior approval targets an older artifact
status.reportingRequired: A complete hash-bound report package is required

conceptual.title: Conceptual model
conceptual.missing: No conceptual-model artifact exists for this analysis.
conceptual.askRepair: Ask agent to design or repair the model
conceptual.repairPrompt: Use $heor-model-design to create or repair heor/conceptual-model.json for the current decision problem. Preserve structural alternatives and uncertainty, run the deterministic validator, and do not create or claim human approval.
conceptual.note: The app audits this independent artifact. Structural completeness permits human review; it does not establish model validity.

library.title: Local evidence library
library.complete: Local sources are hash-bound and searchable
library.incomplete: Local library is empty, stale, or blocked
library.ask: Ask Agent to search the local library
library.searchPrompt: Use $heor-local-evidence to search the current local HEOR evidence library for my research question. Verify heor/evidence-library.json and the source hashes first, use the deterministic local search tool, cite the source path, SHA-256, and page for every claim, and distinguish extracted evidence from interpretation. Do not use the network or claim that an OCR-required or failed document was reviewed.
library.note: Sources stay in heor/library. The app extracts and indexes them locally without a model or network call; exact source hashes and page locators remain reviewable. Scanned PDFs require a separate explicit OCR workflow.
library.noProject: There is no current project for a local evidence library.

search.title: Human-authorized evidence search
search.complete: Exact request is ready for human authorization
search.incomplete: Search request is missing or blocked
search.askDraft: Ask Agent to draft or repair the request
search.repairPrompt: Use $heor-evidence-search to draft or repair heor/evidence-search-request.json for the current evidence gap. Do not make a network call. Use only PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, disclose exactly query, date_from, and date_to as non-sensitive egress, run the portable validator, and leave execution for my explicit review in the AI4HEOR pane.
search.note: The Agent drafts the request; only the desktop app can send the reviewed public query. Retrieved metadata remains not_assessed candidate evidence—not inclusion, appraisal, extraction, or proof of review completeness.
search.dialogBody: The app will bind a local human network-authorization event to request {{hash}} and send only the declared query and dates to fixed public endpoints.
search.rationalePlaceholder: Why this exact query and source set are appropriate for the evidence gap
search.confirm: I reviewed the exact query and sources and confirm they contain no personal, patient-level, confidential, or other sensitive data
search.noProject: There is no current project for an evidence-search request.

synthesis.title: Evidence synthesis ledger
synthesis.complete: Screening, extraction, and conflicts are structurally complete
synthesis.askPrepare: Ask Agent to prepare the synthesis ledger
synthesis.preparePrompt: Use $heor-evidence-synthesis to create or repair heor/evidence-synthesis.json as an importable empty synthesis ledger for the current PICOS question. Preserve existing valid work, run the deterministic validator, and do not fabricate search runs, screening decisions, appraisals, extractions, or human approvals.
synthesis.continue: Ask Agent to continue screening and synthesis
synthesis.continuePrompt: Use $heor-evidence-synthesis to continue the current evidence workflow in heor/evidence-synthesis.json. Preserve app-bound search provenance and all existing human screening decisions. Assess remaining not_assessed candidates, keep exclusions reasoned, extract only supported data, encode candidate model-input values as strict JSON with context in applicability, surface conflicts and limitations, and run the deterministic validator. Do not claim human approval or review completeness unless the artifact proves it.
synthesis.verifyBody: This batch shows {{count}} of {{total}} pending extractions bound to exact synthesis {{hash}}. Select only items you checked against the source.
synthesis.verifyRationale: How you checked the values, source locations, units, and applicability
synthesis.verifyConfirm: I personally checked every selected extraction against its cited source location and confirm the exact value shown. This records one local reviewer label, not verified identity or independent extraction.
synthesis.rejectConfirm: I personally checked and reject all {{count}} selected extractions. They must not enter model inputs until the synthesis is revised and reviewed again.
synthesis.rejectedIssue: Current extraction was rejected and requires a synthesis revision: {{id}}
synthesis.importResult: Imported {{added}} new records and reconciled {{reconciled}} existing records without changing screening decisions.
synthesis.note: The app verifies the authorization chain, run path and SHA-256 before lossless import. Import creates not_assessed candidates only. Model-input extractions need two distinct local-label confirmations and no rejection; this does not prove reviewer identity or independent duplicate extraction.
synthesis.noProject: There is no current project for an evidence-synthesis ledger.

evidence.title: Input traceability
evidence.unverified: Needs another distinct local reviewer confirmation: {{id}}
evidence.rejected: Rejected for the current synthesis version: {{id}}
evidence.askRepair: Ask agent to resolve evidence gaps
evidence.repairPrompt: Audit and repair input traceability in heor/analysis-plan.json using $heor-input-provenance. For new work use analysis schema 0.9.0, preserve valid schema 0.8.0 multi-strategy projects, declare every safe strategy ID in strategy_order with the baseline first, and map every required input for every strategy. Schema 0.9.0 may also use the admitted $heor-background-mortality transformation at an exact declared transition_schedule path. Bind the exact current evidence-synthesis hash and derivation.model_value. Bind every source parameter before transformation, keep unsupported transformations incomplete, and never treat population exchangeability or no-double-counting evidence as human authorization. Never invent or silently fetch evidence, inflation, exchange rates, or life tables, and never claim human verification or approval.
evidence.note: The app independently checks the exact derivation snapshot, strict extracted JSON, direct-value equality, monetary source binding and adjustment arithmetic, synthesis hash, target, record link, and app-owned review chain. Analysis-plan approval stays locked until every selected extraction has two distinct local-label confirmations and no rejection.
evidence.noProject: There is no current project for evidence-to-input selection.
evidence.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before evidence-to-input selection can be audited.

transition.title: Cohort transition structure
transition.askAudit: Ask Agent to audit the cohort model
transition.askRateDerivation: Ask Agent to derive transitions from rates
transition.askSurvivalDerivation: Ask Agent to derive transitions from a survival curve
transition.askSurvivalExtrapolationReview: Ask Agent to review survival fitting and extrapolation
transition.askProbabilityTime: Ask Agent to convert a probability to the model cycle
transition.askBackgroundMortality: Ask Agent to add background mortality
transition.askRelativeEffect: Ask Agent to apply a risk ratio or odds ratio
transition.askHazardRatio: Ask Agent to apply a hazard ratio
transition.ratePrompt: Use $heor-transition-rate-adapter with $heor-input-provenance to inspect the current evidence and derive a schema 0.5.0 transition_matrix or transition_schedule only when constant cause-specific competing event rates, the exact model-cycle length, and one auditable extraction or proposed assumption per event are available. Recompute every row, preserve structural zeros and absorbing rows, and run deterministic validation. If evidence supports rate uncertainty, use $heor-uncertainty-analysis with exact positive event-rate targets so each DSA/PSA run recomputes the complete affected transition input. Correlate rates only when 2–32 members use evidence-bound lognormal distributions and an explicit latent log-scale positive-definite Cholesky matrix. Keep probability-time conversion outside this adapter and route eligible single-event cases to $heor-probability-time-adapter. Keep HR/RR/OR application, pooling, extrapolation, general CTMC matrix exponentiation, within-cycle multiple transitions, time-in-state behavior, arbitrary correlated rate models, and transformation-space structural scenarios explicitly unsupported. Do not claim human verification or approval.
transition.survivalPrompt: Use $heor-survival-curve-adapter with $heor-input-provenance to inspect the current evidence and derive a schema 0.6.0 transition_schedule only for exactly two states and one absorbing all-cause event endpoint with an already-selected exponential or Weibull scale/shape curve. Bind every positive parameter to one strict-JSON extraction or proposed assumption, match the exact model-cycle length, generate every cycle from cumulative-hazard increments, and run portable, browser, native, and deterministic validation. When evidence supports parameter uncertainty, use current $heor-uncertainty-analysis schema 0.6.0; vary only the exact rate_per_year, shape, or scale_years value with gamma, lognormal, or strictly positive uniform sampling, and let every DSA/PSA run recompute the complete schedule. Do not fit or automatically select curves, infer covariance from incomplete fit output, reconstruct IPD, combine PFS and OS, apply HRs, add background mortality or competing risks, claim clinical extrapolation validity, or vary derived probabilities independently. Do not claim human verification or approval.
transition.survivalExtrapolationPrompt: Use natural-language interaction first and forms only as an aid. Use $heor-survival-extrapolation-review to prepare schema 0.2.0 heor/survival-extrapolation-review.json for one absolute time-to-first-event curve. Bind analysis_target to the exact current analysis_id and parametric-survival input_provenance path; stop if the plan contains multiple such targets. Confirm the endpoint, population, curve label, time origin, event/censor definitions, time unit, observed follow-up boundary, model horizon, and data classification. This alpha imports an already-generated local fit bundle; do not open, transform, fit, or transmit patient-level input. Pre-specify 2-8 standard parametric families in the imported protocol, and preserve failed fits and deviations. Bind the exact fit bundle, command, session, fit outputs, KM overlay, log-cumulative-hazard plot, and hazard plot by SHA-256. Compare common observed and extrapolated landmarks, AIC/BIC, hazard shape, external evidence, clinical plausibility, and at least two structural scenarios. Do not auto-select by fit statistics or visual ranking. Keep the gate awaiting_human_selection and require the Human-selected analysis-plan distribution to be a converged candidate. Run the standalone validator with the current analysis plan; the app will independently re-audit and bind the review hash at analysis-plan approval. Route only a selected supported exponential or Weibull curve to $heor-survival-curve-adapter; stop for direct IPD fitting or reconstruction, covariate adjustment, PH pooling, treatment switching, competing/recurrent events, cure/mixture/spline models, or PFS/OS partitioned survival.
transition.probabilityTimePrompt: Use $heor-probability-time-adapter with $heor-input-provenance to inspect the current evidence and derive schema 0.7.0 transitions only when each affected state row has zero or one event, the source probability is strictly between 0 and 1, its source interval is explicit, and a constant hazard over that interval is reviewable. Convert with 1-exp(log(1-p)*model_cycle/source_interval); never divide a probability by the number of cycles. Bind each source probability to one strict-JSON extraction or proposed assumption and recompute the complete matrix or schedule in the portable, browser, native, and deterministic validators. If uncertainty is evidence-supported, use $heor-uncertainty-analysis schema 0.6.0, target only source_probability, use Beta or a Uniform distribution strictly inside (0,1), and recompute the complete transition input for every DSA/PSA run. Stop for competing events, time-varying hazards, probability 0 or 1, HR/RR/OR application, composite endpoints, or clinical appropriateness claims. Do not claim human verification or approval.
transition.backgroundMortalityPrompt: Use natural-language interaction first and forms only as an aid. Use $heor-background-mortality with $heor-input-provenance for analysis schema 0.9.0 only after the human selects the life-table jurisdiction, table year, population, sex, and start age; population exchangeability and no double counting are explicit Human gates. Those two review_bases only record evidence or a proposed assumption; they never authorize the transformation. For exactly two states with death absorbing, align each model cycle to attained age and combine general-population all-cause annual q with one constant non-negative excess hazard using h_bg=-log1p(-q) and p=-expm1(-(h_bg+h_exc)*cycle_length). Bind every q and excess value exactly and run portable, browser, native, and deterministic validation. Pair analysis 0.9.0 with uncertainty 0.8.0; in this first slice vary only the exact positive excess_mortality_rate_per_year value and recompute the full schedule. Do not auto-select or fetch a life table, double count mortality already represented by all-cause OS, vary life-table q, infer semantic approval from review_bases, or claim clinical validity or human approval.
transition.relativeEffectPrompt: Use natural-language interaction first and forms only as an aid. Use $heor-relative-effect-adapter with $heor-input-provenance for analysis schema 0.10.0 only after the human explicitly identifies risk_ratio or odds_ratio, the aligned endpoint and population, the model-cycle baseline risks, and why the effect can remain constant across cycles. Stop if the evidence reports an HR, if RR versus OR is unclear, if endpoint alignment or population transportability is unresolved, or if competing events are present. Require exactly two states with the event state absorbing, effect_interval_years equal to the model cycle, at least one positive baseline q, and exact evidence or proposed-assumption bases for every q, the effect, and all three review bases. Recompute the complete schedule: RR uses q*RR and OR uses OR*q/((1-q)+OR*q); never substitute one measure for another. Pair analysis 0.10.0 with uncertainty 0.9.0 and vary only relative_effect.value. RR DSA and bounded-Uniform PSA highs must be strictly below 1/max(positive baseline q); OR may use Lognormal or a strictly positive bounded Uniform. Keep baseline risks and transformation structure fixed, run portable, browser, native, and deterministic validation, and do not infer causal applicability or human approval from review_bases.
transition.hazardRatioPrompt: Use natural-language interaction first and forms only as an aid. Use $heor-hazard-ratio-adapter with $heor-input-provenance for analysis schema 0.11.0 only after the human has reviewed endpoint alignment, population transportability, proportional hazards within observed follow-up, constant treatment effect over the full modeled horizon, and treatment switching. Require exactly two states with one absorbing time-to-first-event state, one non-negative non-decreasing baseline cumulative hazard for every model cycle, at least one positive hazard increment, and one positive constant HR. Bind every hazard, the HR, and all five review_bases to exact evidence or proposed assumptions. Recompute every cycle with delta_H0=H0(t_i)-H0(t_i-1) and p=-expm1(-HR*delta_H0); never multiply a probability by an HR. Pair analysis 0.11.0 with uncertainty 0.10.0, vary only hazard_ratio.value, and use a strictly positive bounded Uniform whose DSA and PSA highs reproduce a valid schedule. Stop for non-proportional hazards, time-varying HR, treatment-effect waning or stopping, unresolved switching, competing or recurrent events, curve fitting, or partitioned survival. Run portable, browser, native, and deterministic validation and do not infer scientific validity or human approval from review_bases.
transition.repairPrompt: Use $heor-cohort-state-transition to audit or repair the current cohort model. Read the current decision problem, conceptual model, evidence synthesis, analysis plan, input provenance, and uncertainty plan. Use analysis schema 0.10.0 only for the admitted RR/OR relative-effect adapter; preserve valid older schemas. Choose a static transition_matrix unless evidence or an explicit proposed assumption supports a complete transition_schedule. At an exact declared strategy path, use the admitted rate, survival, probability-time, background-mortality, or relative-effect adapter. Natural language is primary and forms are auxiliary. Stop rather than treating HR as RR/OR or silently choosing an effect measure. Bind the complete matrix or schedule through $heor-input-provenance, keep unsupported behavior explicit, run deterministic validation, and do not claim human approval, model validation, reimbursement, or policy advice.
transition.staticNote: Static matrices apply in every model cycle. The deterministic engine remains authoritative for probability, dimension, and cohort-mass checks.
transition.scheduleNote: Schedules use model-cycle time for the whole cohort. Schema 0.9.0 can add an exactly bound, age-aligned background-plus-excess mortality schedule, but life-table choice, population exchangeability, and no double counting remain Human review gates. No schedule establishes clinical validity, time-in-state behavior, or individual simulation.

survivalReview.title: Survival fitting and extrapolation
survivalReview.notRequired: No parametric survival target in this plan
survivalReview.complete: Review is bound to the selected plan curve
survivalReview.recommendation: Analyst recommendation: {{family}}. The analysis-plan gate, not this recommendation, owns selection.
survivalReview.askRepair: Ask Agent to create or repair the survival review
survivalReview.repairPrompt: Use natural language first and $heor-survival-extrapolation-review to create or repair schema 0.2.0 heor/survival-extrapolation-review.json. Match analysis_target to the exact current analysis_id and sole parametric-survival input_provenance path; fail closed for multiple targets. Import only precomputed local survHE evidence, verify every declared hash, retain all pre-specified candidates and failures, compare common observed/extrapolated landmarks and plausibility, keep human_gate awaiting_human_selection, and run the standalone validator against the current analysis plan. Never add approval fields or auto-select a curve.
survivalReview.note: The native app independently checks the target, selected distribution, contract, local hashes, landmarks, diagnostics and scenarios. A complete review still requires Human approval of the whole analysis plan.
survivalReview.noProject: No active project is available for a survival review audit.
survivalReview.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before survival extrapolation can be audited.

reference.title: Reference-case compliance matrix
reference.askRepair: Ask agent to assess or repair reference-case gaps
reference.repairPrompt: Use $heor-reference-case to create or repair heor/reference-case-assessment.json for the exact selected profile. Assess every requirement, preserve gaps and uncertainty, run the deterministic validator, bind the final assessment hash into heor/analysis-plan.json, and do not create or claim human approval.
reference.note: The matrix is bound to the exact profile and assessment bytes. Profile selection alone is not compliance or approval.
reference.noProject: No active project is available for a reference-case audit.
reference.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before the reference-case audit.

uncertainty.title: Executable uncertainty analysis
uncertainty.askRepair: Ask agent to create or repair uncertainty analysis
uncertainty.repairPrompt: Use $heor-uncertainty-analysis to create or repair heor/uncertainty-plan.json for the exact current analysis-plan bytes. Pair analysis 0.10.0 only with uncertainty 0.9.0 and preserve valid older pairs. For a relative-effect transformation, target only relative_effect.value and keep baseline risks, measure, review bases, and schedule structure fixed. RR permits only a strictly positive bounded Uniform PSA distribution, with both DSA high and Uniform high strictly below 1/max(positive baseline q); OR permits Lognormal or strictly positive bounded Uniform. Reject rather than defer invalid bounds that could make a PSA draw produce probability 1 or greater. Structural scenarios may change only cost or utility scalars, discount rates, or half-cycle correction. Derive all ranges and distributions only from linked evidence or explicit human instruction, run deterministic validation, and do not create or claim human approval.
uncertainty.note: The app audits and hash-binds this executable specification. Reproducible simulation is not independent validation or a reimbursement recommendation.
uncertainty.noProject: No active project is available for an uncertainty audit.
uncertainty.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before the uncertainty audit.

budgetImpact.title: Three-year budget impact
budgetImpact.askRepair: Ask the Agent to build or repair budget impact
budgetImpact.repairPrompt: Use $heor-budget-impact to create or repair heor/budget-impact-plan.json against the exact current bytes of heor/analysis-plan.json. For analysis schema 0.8.0 or 0.9.0, explicitly select exactly two distinct IDs from strategy_order as the displaced comparator and new intervention; do not pretend this bounded two-share calculator is a multi-treatment market model. Use a three-year, budget-holder, undiscounted without-access/with-access transparent cost calculator. Record annual eligible population, market shares, treatment and condition-related costs, implementation costs, provenance, one-way ranges, and alternative scenarios. Run the deterministic validator and do not create or claim human approval.
budgetImpact.note: The app independently audits and binds this artifact hash to analysis-plan approval. Budget impact describes payer financial change, not cost-effectiveness or a coverage conclusion.
budgetImpact.noProject: There is no current project for budget impact audit.
budgetImpact.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before budget impact can be audited.

validation.title: Independent model validation
validation.askPrepare: Ask Agent to prepare validation evidence
validation.repairPrompt: Use $heor-model-validation to prepare or audit heor/model-validation.json and local files under heor/validation-evidence/ against the exact current analysis-plan, conceptual-model, uncertainty-plan, and budget-impact-plan bytes. Report face, internal, external, cross-model, predictive, and TECH-VER checks without a score. Preserve all failures and limitations. Do not claim reviewer independence, fill the human declaration or recommendation, or create an approval event.
validation.note: The app verifies structure, hashes, local evidence, coverage, and the declared reviewer boundary. It cannot establish that evidence is true or that the reviewer is genuinely independent.
validation.noProject: There is no current project for model validation audit.
validation.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before model validation can be audited.

reporting.title: Release report package
reporting.releasable: Report package is ready for release review
reporting.askPrepare: Ask Agent to prepare or repair the report package
reporting.repairPrompt: Use $heor-reporting to prepare or repair heor/report-package.json and heor/report.md. Bind the exact current method artifacts and all three app-written deterministic result files; apply CHEERS 2022 only to cost-effectiveness reporting and the separate ISPOR BIA matrix to budget impact; copy result summaries exactly; disclose funding, conflicts, Agent and model-provider involvement, data/model availability, and patient/public involvement. Do not score CHEERS, edit result files, invent the release owner, or create or claim a release approval.
reporting.note: The app verifies reporting structure, hashes, deterministic result reproduction, and local approval state. This is not scientific truth, journal acceptance, or policy endorsement.
reporting.noProject: There is no current project for report-package audit.
reporting.missingPlan: An analysis plan is required before the report package can be audited.

dialog.body: This app-owned event records a local human assertion for artifact {{hash}}. The agent cannot create it.
dialog.expectedReviewer: The reviewer label is bound by the signed validation declaration. Correct the validation report if this identity is wrong.
dialog.rationalePlaceholder: What you checked and why this gate can proceed
dialog.confirmIndependent: I am the declared independent reviewer and personally verified this package for its stated intended use
dialog.confirmRelease: I am the named release owner, reviewed the complete bound report and reproduced results, and accept this local release decision

result.title: Deterministic result
result.authorizedNote: Local human assertion; independent validation and release are still separate gates.
result.releasedNote: Local human release assertion over the exact report, model, validation, and reproduced result bytes; it is not regulatory or reimbursement approval.
result.economicBasisMissing: Legacy exploratory result: currency and price-year basis are not declared.

uncertaintyResult.title: Uncertainty results
uncertaintyResult.ceacSubtitle: Declared threshold grid; probabilities estimated from the same bounded PSA draws.
uncertaintyResult.ceacAria: Line chart of intervention optimal probability and cost-effectiveness acceptability frontier across decision thresholds
uncertaintyResult.thresholdAxis: Maximum acceptable ICER · model currency per QALY
